profile.headline: Senior Data Engineer at Playstation
profile.summary:
To truly maximize the potential and value of an organization’s diverse data, solid data architecture and engineering are essential. I build out and engineer data integration solutions and analytic pipelines to facilitate data-driven insights quickly and reliably.

I am very passionate about adding new technologies and best practices to my skill set in order to build the platforms and processes that will best serve the analytics and data needs of my business client teams. 

I greatly enjoy working with diverse and cross-functional teams that can include anyone from data scientists, business SMEs, product stakeholders, business analysts, and end users.

Projects I have worked on or led include:
Automating complex generation of large (10TB+) datasets with 80+ features for training/testing in deep learning use case (variational autoencoder) with data scientist
Develop, implement and maintain ETL processes in Enterprise Data Warehouse environments
Development of complex data pipelines in Hadoop ecosystem using frameworks such as Spark
Engineering data ingestion of high-volume smart meter data in Hadoop environment, for use in advanced analytics use cases and further aggregation for data warehouse targets
Develop domain specific tools for client needs/use cases using variety of languages/tools (python, golang)

Technologies/Tools
Big Data - Apache ecosystem: Hadoop, HDFS, Spark 1.6.2/2.0, Hive 1.2.1 on Tez, Pig, Oozie 4.2.0, Sqoop 1.4.6, ORC, Parquet
RDBMS/ETL - SQL Server 2012/2016, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, SSIS, 
Data Modeling - Star Schema, Kimball Methodology, Slowly Changing Dimensions, OLAP multidimensional cubes using SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS)
Scripting/Utilities -  Unix/shell scripting, Python 3, Golang (command-line tools)
Programming Languages - Python, Scala (spark), Golang, Bash Shell, T-SQL
Data Visualization - Jupyter and Zeppelin Notebooks, Power BI
VCS/Project Management - Git, Visual Studio Team Services (VSTS)
